title: Paula M NDE 6023
content: A day before this happened to me, I was in a bookstore in Orlando, Florida where I was living at that time. Two different people came up to me and told me I was in grave danger. I was to not go outside of my daily routine. One touched me and I do not like being touched by people I do not know at all, I never have. I stood on the line at the bookstore and I was in shock that two different people had said almost the same thing to me, within a few minutes in time. It did bother me all the way home to my house that was for sure. I had a talk with my four children about this thing that had happened to me in the bookstore. They just said, 'sure mom' as they have known I have had a sixth sense all of my life since I was a small child. I went to bed and I had the most upsetting dream I could have ever imagine. I saw someone inside of a car not a face at all. So I had no idea what it was trying to tell me all I knew was I was going to tell the lady friend I cleaned with that I had seen this and that she was to drive slowly, to all of the people whom we cleaned for. We worked all day long and I waited each time for something to happen. The day ended and I was to go home. I said goodnight to my friend and drove home and I had that feeling that I better just watch where I am going. So I did and I got home and nothing happened at all. I made dinner and fed my kids and I went to bed. I closed my eyes after a while. I was still so worried about what this was to mean. I got up early and went to the gas station; I had enough gas, mind you, at that time. But I had to go there; why? I have no idea, to this day. I got my gas, went back inside of my car, and slowly pulled out of the gas station. The last thing I can remember is my car spinning out of control and I was in a state of shock. Spinning around, I landed on an embankment. I sat there for a long time until I started to have this dream. I had no clue that I was not having a dream. I knew I was in the deepest pain ever. I wanted to die, I did. That pain was like a knife cutting through my body. All of a sudden, I saw a movie being played. I saw my four children crying that I was dead, then I saw my grandma the only one I had loved growing up telling me in a weird tone to fight like I have never ever fought in my entire life, it was not my time to see her again. I had to fight. She would not allow me to die. Then I saw my grandpa. I had loved him so much that my heart died the day he died. He was telling me that I cannot enter that light and I better fight for the life I needed to live as I was not done on this earth. I needed to finish what I was put on this earth to do. They both stood in this light, which was brighter than anything I had ever seen. But I heard their voices to fight and not give up.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Grandparents told her she was "not done on this earth" and needed to "finish what I was put on this earth to do."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Intense pain; perceived it as a dream; saw a "movie" of her children crying that she was dead.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Following the crash and intense pain, she saw a "movie" of her children, then encountered deceased grandparents in a very bright light who told her not to enter the light and to fight/return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Premonitory warnings from two strangers the day before; upsetting dream of someone in a car; long-standing "sixth sense" mentioned.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "They both stood in this light, which was brighter than anything I had ever seen. But I heard their voices to fight and not give up."
